content.text:
Create one coherent 30-second cinematic live-action advertisement scene, landscape 16:9. This is a compassionate, understated workplace tragicomedy: two diligent people discover that the career entrance requirements changed. Real human performances, dry visual humor, no ridicule of unemployed people. Premium film photography, believable scale, fine film grain, restrained dolly movement, natural skin, 35mm and 65mm lenses, motivated soft daylight, subdued blue-grey lobby with warm desk lamp at a nearby worktable. Consistent exposure and color, no dramatic location/time/weather changes.
CAST LOCK throughout all shots: Exactly two main people. Graduate: Chinese woman aged 23, shoulder-length straight black hair, ivory shirt, muted olive cardigan, charcoal trousers, carrying one slim olive document folder with a rolled diploma inside. Experienced worker: Chinese man aged 34, short black hair, thin rectangular black glasses, navy overshirt, grey T-shirt, charcoal trousers, carrying a small brown cardboard office box containing one white mug and one tiny plant, plain worn lanyard. Same faces, hair, glasses, clothes, scale and props in every shot. Neither person talks or lip-syncs. Quiet acting conveyed by hands, eyes, breathing and small pauses.
ONE FIXED LOCATION: a modest contemporary office lobby, one normal waist-high brushed-steel access gate with two small indicator lamps and a card reader. The access gate stays in the same place. Behind it one glass wall. To the LEFT of the gate and accessible from this side of it, a normal-size wooden collaborative worktable with two chairs, an amber desk lamp, a corkboard, blank paper cards, a small binder, a capped green pen. No computers, no monitors, no futuristic equipment. Establish gate AND table in opening wide frame. Floor plan never changes. Characters remain on the entrance side; no magically crossing a closed gate. Do not introduce a receptionist or teacher.
TIMED EDIT AND ACTION:
0.0-2.0: wide symmetrical establishing shot, woman left and man right approaching the single gate from foreground. Table clearly visible at far left. They stop naturally, tired but hopeful.
2.0-6.5: medium close profile of woman, she carefully takes her diploma from folder and presents it to reader. Insert of a real hand holding diploma near reader: small red lamp and one polite rejection beep. Cut back to her: she flattens a tiny crease on diploma, tries to preserve dignity, then slowly lowers it. Diploma has no readable text.
6.5-11.5: man gently puts his box on floor on his RIGHT, straightens old lanyard and confidently presents plain badge to same reader. Red lamp, identical rejection beep. His practiced professional smile fades very slightly. He glances at the badge as if it betrayed him. Keep box on right floor with plant and mug.
11.5-16.5: unhurried medium two-shot, woman left, man right. They look at the closed gate, then at each other. The man gives a tiny, embarrassed half-shrug; woman releases an almost-smile of recognition. Hold genuine 1.5-second quiet eye contact. Audience laughs with them, not at them. Do not add a joke reaction face or look at camera.
16.5-20.5: woman notices the already-established warmly lit table to their LEFT. She gestures gently toward its empty chairs. Man picks up the SAME box from his right. In continuous lateral dolly, follow them three ordinary steps LEFT to the table, gate still visible behind right. No doorway crossing, hidden corridor or teleportation. They sit woman left, man right; box placed on floor beside his chair.
20.5-26.5: same table, two carefully motivated closer cuts. They collaborate: woman arranges three blank business-process paper cards and draws connecting lines; man checks a separate paper checklist, points out one missed dependency with capped pen, she repositions ONE card. Concrete quiet collaborative work, no rubber stamps, no fake screens, no instant success celebration. Do not change props or hand identities. One original diploma remains beside her folder.
26.5-30.0: settled medium two-shot. They exchange a small determined nod and return to work. Gently ease camera back to include the closed gate in background right and the warmly lit table in foreground left. End with both STILL WORKING, not walking through gate and not claiming a job offer. Keep lower 15 percent clear for later subtitles, upper-right uncluttered for later editorial text. Hold final composition stable for last second.
AUDIO IS REQUIRED: generate an original continuous subtle instrumental soundtrack with sparse pizzicato low strings at opening and a gentle warm piano motif entering around 20 seconds, no famous melody, no vocals. Quiet office ventilation, real soft footsteps, paper rustle, cardboard movement, exactly two restrained gate rejection beeps at approximately 4 and 9 seconds. Lower music nearly to silence during the 12-16 second eye contact, then return softly. No spoken dialogue, no narration, no singing: Chinese narration will be mixed separately from approved ElevenLabs recording. No canned laughter, no cartoon sounds, no epic trailer percussion.
No subtitles, no readable typography, no logo, no UI, no floating holograms. No montage into another room. Realistic ordinary dimensions. Preserve both identities and geography through every cut. This entire 30 seconds is one internally consistent scene, not five unrelated clips.
